caption: Linear interpolation leaves corners at each key; Hermite tangents pass through the same keys smoothly. Sampling at t only needs the two surrounding keys.
Vertices weighted 0.25, 0.5 and 0.75 to the forearm move only part of the way as the elbow bends, so the skin stays connected across the joint.
As speed rises from 0 to 6 m/s, weight flows from idle to walk to run; at any speed at most two clips are blended and the weights sum to 1.
Drawn to scale: the same 2048 x 2048 texture is 21.3 MB as RGBA32 and 2.5 MB as ASTC 6x6, and mips add a third on top of every format.
Cells ahead of the player start loading before the player reaches them, and cells left behind unload once they fall outside the unload distance.
Same allocations, same 200 MB free: interleaved lifetimes leave only 25 MB holes, while a per-level arena frees one contiguous block.
One tick, left to right: Flee fails at its first condition, Attack succeeds twice and returns Running at Fire, so lower-priority branches never run.
The Manhattan heuristic pulls expansion toward the goal; the open set spreads around the wall only where it has to before the path is found.
A* over seven polygons gives a zigzag through their centres; the funnel algorithm turns the same corridor into a straight path that bends only at corners.
To scale: a press 40 ms before landing still jumps inside the 120 ms buffer, and a press 60 ms after leaving a ledge still jumps inside the 100 ms coyote window.
The client never waits: when the server's state for #57 arrives, it drops #57 and replays #58 to #60 on top of the authoritative state.
The server keeps a short hitbox history and rewinds the target 150 ms, 100 ms of interpolation plus 50 ms of travel, to test the shot where the shooter saw it.
